mainText: <speak><voice name="Joey">Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies and 70 degree temperatures out at the Military Ridge State Trail, under the glow of a full moon.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kendra">The city is currently seeking votes for the I Voted sticker design contest, open through August 7, and the Senior Center is reminding residents to submit their waivers for the popular tri-shaw program, which offers scenic bike rides along the local trails.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">We have a packed schedule with trivia at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Ivy">Regarding the weekly safety report, on July 26, an 83-year-old driver was cited for an improper left turn and a hit and run crash near the intersection of West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">It is a perfect day for the Georgia Peach flavor, and while the shop is currently closed, you can grab a scoop starting at 10 AM today. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow features Caramel Peanut Buttercup.</voice></speak>
